items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I read about Leonidas incidentally. You know, Leonidas was a great warrior or something; he held the bridge with a thousand men

ctx.x: Lee, I see in two biographies on you, in the Chilton and Feather books, that your full name is -- well, you pronounce it.
Leonidas. Leonidis. It's a Greek pronunciation, isn't it?
